description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.9 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Read-only client connection view and Claude first-party preview (#9108)
- Validate inline edit sources without decoding them (#9072)
- List local Claude Code sessions (#8992)
- Reuse parsed tool ranges in completed answers (#9068)
- Per-account diagnostics with eligibility, refresh outcome and cooldown (#9109)
- Add quota-only failover and a same-model guard (#9089)
- Persist API-key cooldowns across restarts (#9107)
- Manage quota-only failover from the API and CLI (#9090)
- Add Spanish dashboard and README (#8706)
- Opt in to batching private ACL restrictions (#8996)
- Per-account routes for Codex pool accounts (#9113)
- Add fallback presets and a route preview to the Combo editor (#9091)
- Add SWE-2.1 to the Devin provider (#9127)
- Carry video input where a wire publishes it, refuse it everywhere else (#9131)
- OpenAI Videos wire for images.videoProvider and public /v1/videos (#9128)
